newsitem.title: USA: Dyersburg names Jerome Wiggins president.
newsitem.headline: Dyersburg names Jerome Wiggins president.

text.p: Dyersburg Corp said Wednesday it named Jerome Wiggins as president and chief operating officer of the company.
T. Eugene McBride, who previously held the position of president, will continue to serve as chairman and chief executive officer, it said.

The company said Wiggins joined the company in 1989 and served as vice president, chief financial officer, treasurer and secretary until December 1995, when he was named to the newly established position of president-Dyersburg Operations.
The company said that the position of chief operating officer is a new one and that the position of president-Dyersburg Operations will not be filled.
